switch-tab-2.description: Switch to the second unpinned tab

switch-tab-3.description: Switch to the third unpinned tab

switch-tab-4.description: Switch to the fourth unpinned tab

switch-tab-5.description: Switch to the fifth unpinned tab

switch-pinned-tab-1.description: Switch to the first pinned tab

switch-pinned-tab-2.description: Switch to the second pinned tab

switch-pinned-tab-3.description: Switch to the third pinned tab

switch-pinned-tab-4.description: Switch to the fourth pinned tab

switch-pinned-tab-5.description: Switch to the fifth pinned tab

description: Switch unpinned tabs with Ctrl+Number and pinned tabs with Alt+Shift+Number. Ctrl+9 and Alt+Shift+9 jump to the last tab in that group.
name: Ctrl+Number to switch tabs
